answer_3.quote: We conduct a comparison with ChatGPT by providing it with instructions based on the task description of the susceptibility level comparison setting in a zero-shot manner ... We notice that our model even outperforms predictions made by ChatGPT, despite Chat-GPT being a significantly larger model than ours.

answer_4.quote: During human judgment, annotators are tasked with selecting the more susceptible user based on five historical tweets for each user... We recruited human annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) in the U.S. and compensated each annotator with $0.5 ... Our model achieves an agreement of 72.90% with human predictions, indicating a solid alignment with the annotations provided by human evaluators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose which of the two users appears more susceptible to COVID-19 misinformation, using options: Definitely User A, Probably User A, Definitely User B, Probably User B.
